cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(hunspell LANGUAGES CXX)

# hunspell ships autotools only; this builds just the library, no tools.
add_library(hunspell STATIC
    src/hunspell/affentry.cxx
    src/hunspell/affixmgr.cxx
    src/hunspell/csutil.cxx
    src/hunspell/filemgr.cxx
    src/hunspell/hashmgr.cxx
    src/hunspell/hunspell.cxx
    src/hunspell/hunzip.cxx
    src/hunspell/phonet.cxx
    src/hunspell/replist.cxx
    src/hunspell/suggestmgr.cxx
)

# hunvisapi.h is generated by configure. HUNSPELL_STATIC picks the empty
# LIBHUNSPELL_DLL_EXPORTED, so the visibility attribute branch is never used.
set(HAVE_VISIBILITY 0)
configure_file(src/hunspell/hunvisapi.h.in src/hunspell/hunvisapi.h @ONLY)

target_compile_definitions(hunspell PUBLIC HUNSPELL_STATIC)
target_compile_definitions(hunspell PRIVATE BUILDING_LIBHUNSPELL _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
target_include_directories(hunspell SYSTEM PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/src")

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(hunspell PRIVATE /wd4244 /wd4267 /wd4996 /wd4018 /wd4267)
endif()
